gloss: to end up doing (contraction of てしまう)

definitions.gloss: to end up doing; to completely do
definitions.explanation: casual contraction of てしまう (te-shimau); expresses completion of an action, often with a sense of regret, finality, or doing something unintentionally

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}→寝坊：01692_nebou⟧しちゃった。
⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{捨|す}て→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ちゃった。
examples.english: I threw away an important document by mistake.

notes:
CASUAL CONTRACTION:
ちゃう is the casual spoken contraction of てしまう:
- て + しまう → ちゃう
- で + しまう → じゃう

USAGE:
- Completion: ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ちゃった (I ate it all)
- Regret: ⟦{壊|こわ}し→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ちゃった (I broke it... oops)
- Unintentional: ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ちゃった (I accidentally forgot)

REGISTER:
Casual speech only. Use てしまう / てしまいました in polite/formal contexts.

WATCH OUT:
- 〜ちゃ / 〜じゃ (as in ⟦{言|い}っ→言う：00515_iu⟧ちゃ⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧, "you mustn't say it") is a different contraction, of ては / ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧.
- In Kansai speech, ちゃう also means ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ ("that's not right").
